title: sharm, mapgr (2 inputs), mapgrentropy: DMSO-water (distinct molecules)
purpose: Exercises `sharm` for two different molecule types and the downstream programs `mapgr` and `mapgrentropy` [@epsrmanual], including more than 100 coefficients (two coefficient files) and the reading of coefficients with the second molecule at the origin.
fortran: `sharm_rev2.f`: `run_sharm` (keywords, `nsumt` rule), `sharm` (centres, axes, pair loop, averaged molecules)
system: The EPSR-test configuration `200DMSO400Water.ato`: 200 DMSO (atoms S, C, C, O, 6 H) and 400 water molecules (O1, H1, H1; SPC/E parameters [@berendsen1987]), 3200 atoms at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å, a model of the DMSO-water mixtures of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. `sharm` expands the orientational pair correlation function of a central and a second molecule type in rotation matrices coupled by Clebsch-Gordan coefficients; the coefficients g(l1,l2,l;n1,n2;r) are averages over all molecule pairs [@soper1994,@graygubbins1984]. Central molecule DMSO (centre = mass centre of S and O, z axis S to O, y axis towards the C-C midpoint), second molecule water; distinct types (`ldistinct = 1`) use both the "molecule 1 at origin" and "molecule 2 at origin" pair passes. l1 = 0-3, l2 = 0-2, l = 0-4, n1step 1, n2step 2 (negative n2 terms) give 139 coefficients, written to `.h01` and `.h02`. `mapgr` rebuilds g(r) along chosen directions and relative orientations from the coefficients (grtype 1 radial, 2 spatial, 3 full orientational). `mapgrentropy` adds to the ideal-gas entropy the two-body excess term, an integral of r²·(g - 1 - g ln g) [@baranyai1989], for the radial, spatial and full g, sampling random orientations with `ran1` [@parkmiller1988].
inputs: Input files written by hand from the keyword tables (`setup_symbols_*`), one `keyword value` per line, ended by `q`; `200DMSO400Water.ato` copied from EPSR-test. `dmsowat.mapgr.txt`: 4 views, one with an unreadable `theta_phi` (skipped), smoothing `2.5 3 2 1`; `watdmso.mapgr.txt`: `shcoeffs dmsowat` (extension added by `check_symbol`), `ident -1`, `mirrorsym y`; entropy from 150 trials.
verification: One pass with four program calls. The reference `.SHARM.dat` shows `ncoeffs 139` and `nsumt 1`; the `.h02` file holds the columns after the first 100. Both `.mapgr.g01` files, the entropy output and `ran1.dat` are compared. Reference build: `sharm`/`sdf` were rebuilt with one comma inserted in the run-time title format (`'(1h(,'//il1fmt`), since gfortran 15.2 otherwise stops with "Missing comma between descriptors" before writing the coefficients; all other programs are the unmodified reference binaries. Also masked: characters 31-45 of the `*.mapgr.g01` data lines, the error column of `g_centres(r)`, which `mapgrquad.f` never sets (uninitialised in the Fortran, 0 in the port).
